achievements.admin.title: Global achievements
achievements.admin.subtitle: Achievements for the whole network, including the certificates awarded automatically.
achievements.board.introRegion: Achievements thank members for special commitment in this region. They appear on the profile, depending on their visibility.
achievements.board.introGlobal: Global achievements can be awarded to every active member. The hygiene and key account manager certificates are awarded automatically.
achievements.board.emptyAdmin: Define the first achievement and award it to members.
achievements.board.emptyMember: The region’s ambassadors define and award achievements.
achievements.board.deleteText: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody holds this achievement. It disappears from the list.} one {1 member holds this achievement. It disappears from the list and from the profile.} other {# members hold this achievement. It disappears from the list and from their profiles.}}
achievements.card.awarded: {count, plural, =0 {Not awarded yet} one {Awarded once} other {Awarded # times}}
achievements.visibilityHint.HIDDEN: Only administrators see the award – not even the recipient.
achievements.visibilityHint.PRIVATE: The recipient and the administrators see the award.
achievements.visibilityHint.STORE_MANAGE: Store managers of the region, the recipient and the administrators see the award.
achievements.visibilityHint.SCOPE: Members of the region see the award on the profile.
achievements.visibilityHint.GLOBAL: Everybody sees the award on the profile.
achievements.duplicateHint.OVERRIDE: Awarding it again extends the active award.
achievements.duplicateHint.MULTIPLE: Every award is listed on its own.
achievements.form.name: Name
achievements.form.baseUnknown: The German text is not shown while you use another language. Leave the German fields empty to keep it.
achievements.form.translationNameMissing: A translated description needs a name in the same language: {languages}
achievements.award.title: Award “{name}”
achievements.award.overrideHint: If the member already holds it, the active award is extended.
achievements.awards.title: Awards of “{name}”
achievements.awards.revokeText: The achievement disappears from the profile. The award stays in this list as revoked.
